Cooperative source is generated by the retained source-faithful implementation, with only the entry name and caller-contract comment normalized. Native IR inputs are ../masked.ttgir and ../padded.ttgir. These fixtures test exact default parity and lowered recurrence; they are not independent numerical oracles. Native execution uses a separate FP64 oracle.
